counts_are: Actor representation-record counts only, not physical glyph/body counts, class counts, glyph existence results, or cross-reader correspondence.
what_was_performed: Both original faces of each selected card, all edges, writing rows/continuations, ordinary objects and visible mark/stain regions were viewed. Broad fixed row intervals were retained as span observations with verbal contour descriptions and separate selected mark records.
what_was_not_performed: Defensible per-body approximate individual locator and two per-body neighboring-contour descriptions
Independent per-body head fork/curl/loop/bar, intermediate crossing, stem/descent/hook/returning loop/left bowl/foot feature states
Per-body component references and ownership decisions
Exhaustive individually separated detached mark inventory with affiliations
Distinguishing every unknown feature caused by locally hidden/merged ink from unknown features caused simply by omitted individual enumeration
local_ambiguity_scope: Frozen descriptions retain actual local stain/transfer intersections, descending-stroke crossings, underline crossings, and mark proximity. These local observations do not prove that all contours within any retained broad interval are inseparable.
reason_for_unfulfilled_endpoint: Reader used coarse finite row intervals rather than performing required body-level enumeration. General unresolved-partition/ownership wording in frozen records does not independently establish local ambiguity for every included body or feature. Approximate context locators were permitted; exact ink segmentation was not required, and its prohibition is not a reason to omit observable complete contours.
interpretation_limit: This is an incomplete body-level observation endpoint, not a negative result about existence or visibility of any glyph construction. No mapping-ready absence/class outcome can be inferred.
stop_status: All card records remain frozen; no re-view/refinement of prior cards and no Stage2 mapping received.
